page_title: LIV 2-2 FUL | Liverpool v Fulham 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Tony Harrington has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+8' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

90+6' Adama Traore (Fulham) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Alisson pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
90+5' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+4' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
90+1' Liverpool can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
88' What was Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
87' None of the Fulham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Wilson leaves the pitch and Adama Traore (Fulham) comes on.
86' 2 - 2 Goal! Darwin Nunez pulls the ball back for Diogo Jota (Liverpool) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
83' Sander Berge (Fulham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
82' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
82' Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
79' Alisson (Liverpool) is able to continue to play.
79' Arne Slot prepares a substitution. Trent Alexander-Arnold is replaced by Diogo Jota (Liverpool).
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) for Dominik Szoboszlai.
78' The game is interrupted now, Alisson (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' 1 - 2 Goal! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
73' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' Excellent touch by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
70' The substitution is prepared. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cody Gakpo.
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Curtis Jones walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jarell Quansah (Liverpool).
69' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Andreas Pereira will be replaced by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).
68' Substitution. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Raul Jimenez walks off.
68' What a miskick by Sasa Lukic (Fulham). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
66' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
65' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
59' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
57' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
57' Referee Tony Harrington has finally had enough of Arne Slot and brandishes a yellow card at him!
57' Fulham hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno was alert and the score remains the same.
55' Marco Silva is forced to make a change. Kenny Tete is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
52' Kenny Tete (Fulham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' Kenny Tete (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

49' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Bernd Leno pulls off an easy save.
49' Referee Tony Harrington points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Liverpool players.
49' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.

47' 1 - 1 Mohamed Salah sends a superb cross into the box. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Bernd Leno beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
46' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) makes a slide tackle, but referee Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
45+5' Harry Wilson (Fulham) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
45+4' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45+2' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Liverpool.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
42' A pass by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
41' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
39' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
35' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
35' The ball possession is 60:40.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
31' Harry Wilson (Fulham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
30' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is given a yellow card.
27' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends the corner into the box, but Alisson intercepts it and averts the threat.
26' An attempted cross from Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is cleared. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
25' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Liverpool.
23' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
22' Harry Wilson (Fulham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
21' Harry Wilson (Fulham) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
20' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Andrew Robertson (Liverpool): it’s upheld, he has to go!

16' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool), but referee Tony Harrington must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
16' The game is interrupted as Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is sent off by the referee.
15' Some patient build-up play from Fulham as they look to unlock the defence.
14' Sander Berge (Fulham) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Andreas Pereira (Fulham) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Alisson. He makes it 0:1.
9' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Andreas Pereira (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
8' A pass from Harry Wilson (Fulham) is intercepted by Alisson and the move breaks down.
7' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
4' The Liverpool players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
4' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
3' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' Issa Diop (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Tony Harrington and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
1' Fulham keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Fulham will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tony Harrington.
